Fly-on-the-wall documentary following the men and women who defend Australia from drug runners, smugglers and terrorists. (S5, ep 5)
A Canadian crosses the Ambassador Bridge in Detroit by mistake and her bag of medicinal marijuana may cost her. (S1, ep 15)
In New York City, a laptop belonging to a Caribbean traveller does not compute and a young Brit arrives at Detroit Metro Airport to visit an American cyber pal. (S1, ep 16)
We bring you action packed rescues, not-so smooth criminals, and some of the most extraordinary and downright spooky moments ever caught on film. (S3, ep 8)
Officers work with citizens to save an overdosed man and an intoxicated man gives officers a tough time about leaving a bus stop. Flashing images. (S2, ep 39)
A woman brings contents of her fridge with her, a suspicious clock at the mail centre has officers worried and a man returning from Cambodia raises alarms. (S17, ep 15)
Officers uncover a smuggling effort at the mail centre, two passengers from Taiwan are caught lying and packages of undeclared kava raise officers' suspicions. (S17, ep 16)
A drunk passenger has officers on high alert, a box of clothing may be hiding something sinister and officers interrogate a student about fraudulent documents. (S17, ep 17)
A travel guide makes a mistake that could cost him thousands, officers intercept a strange shipment and the legitimacy of a student's visa comes into question. (S17, ep 18)
From mega wipeouts to parking wars, animal chaos and two wheeled smashes, we've got it all caught on camera. (S4, ep 5)
Aurora: The crew discovers a decrepit warship whose ancient crew are frozen in stasis pods and live in a virtual world. But it's a world infiltrated by a Wraith in disguise... (S2, ep 9)
Alter Ego: Ensign Kim asks Tuvok to teach him Vulcan emotional control techniques when he falls in love with a holodeck character named Marayna. (S3, ep 14)
First Born: A mysterious family friend arrives to help transform Worf's reluctant son Alexander into a warrior.
Kekoa (Warrior): The team investigate the brutal murder of a traditional fighting master. Plus, McGarrett gets more than he bargained for while keeping tabs on his mother. (S3, ep 16)
...Adventure: Two failing teens travel through time to gather history's greatest figures for the ultimate school report. (1989)
Wesenrein: Nick and Hank finally bring Wu into the fold as they race to save Monroe from the Wesenrein. (S4, ep 9)
The largest football stadium in the United States is turned into an ice hockey rink. Plus, robots are programmed to mass-produce cars.
Over a century of Italian craftsmanship is squeezed into an accordion. Workers create callers that make duck hunters sound just like their prey.
Lost Relics. The team find lost relics of bygone times, including stools made for child-workers at an old hat dyer's factory and some classic fairground art.
Best Sellers. The team hunt for items their clients will love. In Lancashire Viki buys a set of laboratory lamps, in London Serkan nabs a 1930s papier mâché lion.
Citroen DS & Lotus 7. Paul wants to buy a Citroen DS, but Drew has major reservations. This banged up classic car is priced at £6,500- will the guys take it on?
More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including automotive fuel pumps, cricket bats, change machines and ductile iron pipe.
More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including wooden barrels, fire hydrants, automotive seats and cathode ray tubes.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
Star Wars Revival. The force is strong with paper conservator Ashleigh as she restores an original Star Wars poster. And upholsterer Ray updates a pair of 1960s designer chairs.
Downside. Drew visits a hip dealer in Manchester, haggles with a windmill manager in Kent and seeks artefact redemption at a Somerset abbey. Plus, he moves shop after 10 years.
Dartmouth Steam Railway. Drew is in Scotland to see a Victorian theatre in Aberdeen and the remote town of Rothes. Tee shows him how to do a deal at a steam railway in Devon.
Permit delays force the Poseidon Crew off road as they try to survive the season. Plus, the Dust Devils gamble big in the hope of finding fine gold.
Marcus and Linden fear a flat battery could leave them stuck in the outback for days. Plus, Shane and Russell attempt to get their season on track.
Mega Wash Plant. The Bushmen's new claim turns dangerous, forcing Rod and Les to choose between riches and safety. Plus, the Young Guns demolish their old mine.
Dreams. Chris Cheal's dream of two mining teams struggles to launch. Meanwhile, the Blacklighters gamble on a new claim to break a month-long opal drought.
Drew visits a huge antiques warehouse in Belfast. On the lookout for 18th century Irish furniture, he's excited to spot a mahogany chest of drawers.
1950 Austin Atlantic. Henry and Fuzz head to Bristol to see Robert's 1950 Austin Atlantic. Faded and forgotten for years, can they revive this bold British classic?
Robin Burford. The boys visit Rob, who has an impressive collection of vintage British bikes. They find a BSA Bantam and a classic 1930's Austin Ten automobile.
Paul Webb. Henry and Fuzz visit Paul in the Malvern Hills, a man with a perfectly maintained collection of Japanese motorbikes including a Honda 750 Four.

items.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
items.sum: Henry and Simon are in Buckinghamshire to rummage through a storage unit full of potential. They pick up a sliding cupboard and a cubbyhole shelving unit.
Les Dennis & Sherrie Hewson. Angus unearths some family fortunes at comedy legend Les Dennis' home. Then, he checks out a selection of movie memorabilia at Sherrie Hewson's house.
Huge Bids For A Rare Collection. Angus uncovers a loft stashed with bizarre but highly valuable collectables. Plus, a set of rare stamps deliver a big cash windfall at auction.
Treasures Of Scotland. Can Margie Cooper make it a clean sweep as she and Mark Hill head for the heart of Edinburgh in a 1980 MGB Roadster?
Helen Flanagan & Bobby Davro. Actress Helen Flanagan asks Angus to sell some Corrie keepsakes and haute couture, while comedian Bobby Davro brings coins and sporting memorabilia.
The experts are entranced by a three-dimensional portrait of a Hindu goddess. Plus, they revive a birdwatcher's binoculars and a broken silver locket.
The team revive a rusty chrome calendar ornament. They restore a 1930s schoolbook from Trinidad and a sweet little wind instrument called an ocarina.
Workers manufacture toilets that massage and blow-dry. The Navy tests a pilotless helicopter. A jackhammer that doesn't cause the shakes is built.
The secrets behind keeping the cars of Daytona on the track for 24 hours of racing are revealed. The sweetest sugarcane is turned into Caribbean rum.
A celebration of Naked Attraction's very best naughty bits, revisiting times when the show broke new dating ground, including when trans woman and celebrity Lauren Harries entered a pod.
More hopeful singletons visit the First Dates restaurant. Will vet Simon see past lawyer Arunima's wheelchair? And can Londoners Suzie and Gareth find that certain spark?
What do Britain's top armchair critics think of Squid Game: The Challenge, The Couple Next Door, The Toy Hospital, Survivor, Vinnie Jones in the Country and Lorraine?
Brand new series - 2 Ava 2 Fest: Ava Fest is back, and with the help of the teachers, Ava's determined to outdo last year by any means necessary.
The Flandshees of Innersimpson: Flanders vows never to speak to Homer again after Homer steals his new headphones. Homer's absolutely delighted - at first...
Sixteen Candles: Murray and Beverly forget Adam's 16th birthday.
You Got Zuko'd: Adam's girlfriend Jackie returns from her summer in New York but acts like a different person. Beverly is unhappy with Lainey's culinary skills.
Double-Click: Claire can't seem to find the right time to fire an employee, Phil thinks he caught Luke with a girl in his bed, and no one notices that Alex has moved back.
Bride Lauren and music-mad Perry are under the spotlight as they look back on their gig-themed wedding at a popular London music venue. (Ep5)
The Day We Almost Died: A near miss from a crash leaves everyone in the car either on edge or adopting a new 'live for the moment' mentality.
The Big Guns: Claire's fury about the ugly boat on neighbours Ronnie and Amber's front lawn soon develops into all-out war.
A short, cheeky clip featuring animals and food, from the always hilarious Tube that is Rude.
In Bristol, Lee and Nicky serve an Italian menu, but are their portions too big? A scary doll joins the guests for dinner at Libby and Graham's. And Nico and Sky host a Mexican fiesta.
La Galleria 33 (Part 1/2): Gordon tries to help La Galleria 33, run by sisters Rita and Lisa, who blame the restaurant's failures on everything from tablecloths to the weather.
La Galleria 33 (Part 2/2): The saga of Boston eatery La Galleria 33 comes to a dramatic conclusion as Gordon Ramsay gives restaurant owners and sisters Rita and Lisa an ultimatum.
Alfonso Ribeiro hosts as home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments, like when a dad discovers his toddler has covered himself and his car seat with Nutella!
Just Infatuation: Will and Carlton spy on Ashley when she goes on a date with famous young rapper Little T.
Working It Out: To keep her new job as personal assistant to a film star (guest star Queen Latifah), Hilary has to agree to a date with Will's best friend, Jazz. Series finale.
Gump Roast: Aliens Kang and Kodos decide that Homer is the 'fat, selfish epitome of modern man' and that Earth must be destroyed. Guest starring Stephen Hawking and U2.
I Am Furious Yellow: Bart becomes an animator and finds inspiration close to home when he creates his lead character: Angry Dad.
Little Girl in the Big Ten: Lisa pretends to be a student so that she can hang out with some college girls. Meanwhile, Bart is bitten by a mosquito.
Frying Game: Homer and Marge are framed for murder and face the electric chair. Guest starring Carmen Electra as herself.
Rad!: Erica thinks her singing dreams have come true when she lands a job at a new karaoke bar in town. Murray teaches Barry and Lainey financial responsibility.
Hersheypark: When Adam tells Beverly that he doesn't want her to chaperone the school trip to a theme park, she tries to manipulate him with 'guilt letters'.
Weathering Heights: Phil's excited when he's invited onto the local news. And his day gets even better when he meets his weatherman hero, Rainer Shine (guest star Nathan Fillion).
Halloween 4: The Revenge of Rod Skyhook: Luke's Halloween party isn't going well. The Dunphys decide it needs a visit from Rod Skyhook, some promotion and adult supervision...
Grab It!: Jay's favourite place in the world may be losing some of its charm when Phil considers becoming a member. And Claire mistakes her influence on Alex's life choices.
Thanksgiving Jamboree: Phil spares no expense on a Thanksgiving jamboree. And Hayley has to tell her dad that she'd rather spend the holidays with her boyfriend.
Specs and the City: Mr Burns gives his employees augmented reality glasses for Christmas so that he can spy on them, but the gift strains Homer and Marge's marriage.
The Man Who Grew Too Much: Sideshow Bob becomes chief scientist at a genetically modified food company.
Diggs: When school bullies pick on Bart, he's rescued by new student Diggs (Daniel Radcliffe), who is devoted to the sport of falconry and aspires to take to the sky himself.
The Winter of His Content: Marge invites Grampa and two other octogenarians to live at home with the family, but she's frustrated when Homer embraces their elderly lifestyle.
Skinner's Sense of Snow: When a huge snowdrift engulfs the school, Bart leads the kids in a rebellion, gagging Principal Skinner and tying him to a chair as they run amok.
Brand new series - Double Date: Jacob and Gregory go on a double date, but they run into some familiar faces. Ava's first book club meet turns into a post-apocalyptic debate.
Cased Up: When Will is involved in a car accident with Hilary's new boyfriend, Uncle Phil has to defend his underage and uninsured nephew in court.
Hi-Ho Silver: Will and Carlton suspect that their glamorous movie-star neighbour, Sonya Lamor (guest star Zsa Zsa Gabor), has stolen the Banks' heirloom silverware.
(2014) Adult comedy sequel. The lads visit Jay in Australia after he tells them he's living a life of hedonism and sexual promiscuity as a superstar DJ.
It's a week of shocks for Natalie when she's presented with a septuagenarian suitor before her keeper announces that he's a vampire.
(2023) Brandon Cronenberg's intense psychological horror with Alexander Skarsgård and Mia Goth. When a rich tourist accidentally kills someone, he gets cloned to avoid the death penalty.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
(1954) Cold War thriller. Richard Widmark stars as the leader of a submarine expedition, sent to the frozen depths of Alaska to thwart the Chinese communists' plans to start WWIII.
(1943) Drama. Director Sam Wood's epic adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's classic story about the Spanish Civil War. Starring Oscar-nominees Gary Cooper and Ingrid Bergman.
(1954) Oscar-nominated Humphrey Bogart, in one of his finest roles, stars in Edward Dmytryk's gripping drama as Captain Philip Queeg, in charge of a US Navy minesweeper during the war.
(1994) Oscar-winning turn-of-the-century drama with Brad Pitt and Anthony Hopkins. A Montana patriarch's son falls for his brother's fiancée, setting off a tragic chain of events.
(2022) It's Predator, 1719 style. Amber Midthunder stars as a Comanche hunter who must save her tribe from an extraterrestrial threat in this action prequel. If it bleeds, you can kill it.
(2022) Ti West's exuberant retro horror and prequel to X. Mia Goth is Pearl - a twisted Dorothy who wants to dance up the yellow brick road to movie stardom. Can a seedy projectionist help?
Uncle Tom's Cabin. The team of paranormal experts visit an inn in Wincanton, Somerset, and witness some unusual activity. Plus, Jane finds herself at the mercy of a possible spirit. S2, Ep5
Chilmark Manor House. A man calls the team in to investigate his childhood home in Chilmark. Having recently moved back in, he and his family have been terrified by strange events. S2, Ep6
Teleshopping.
Treading New Ground. Treading new ground across the UK, Drew and Viki explore the factory complex of a historic British cloth producer and a sprawling reclamation yard. S18, Ep12
Conversation Starters. Drew and Alister's hunt for pieces with an interesting backstory takes them from Sussex to Shropshire with campaign furniture and quirky collectables. S18, Ep13
Gaby Roslin helps singer and TV presenter Mica Paris find a home-away from home in Sardinia. She has a budget of £850,000 for a beautiful home with a sea-view. S1, Ep7
Your one-stop-shop for all things cruise; bringing you the hottest destinations, ground-breaking ships and the latest deals to ensure your next cruise is your greatest one!
Episode 95. British couples seek to swap grey skies for sun, sea and sand abroad. With the help of property experts, can they find the home of their dreams? S1, Ep15
Drew heads to a huge antiques wholesaler in Exeter, where he finds pile upon pile of affordable gems. Next, it's on to north London, to visit an emporium of curiosities. S13, Ep6
Drew heads to Devon, where he finds a wealth of unusual oddities housed in a country pub. Next, it's on to Hastings, which has enjoyed a recent resurgence in the antiques trade. S13, Ep7
Seeing an untapped source of rare items, Drew tours Catalonia looking for some chic Spanish antiques. In Peralada, Drew is blown away by a 17th Century house full of treasures. S13, Ep8
Catherine Southon and Philip Serrell travel along the beautiful west country coastline. The pair eventually end up at an auction house in Bristol. S13, Ep14
Catherine Southon and Philip Serrell battle it out for one final time. The duo travel through South Wales, finally ending up at their last auction in Wells, Somerset. S13, Ep15
Toy restorers Amanda and Julie work on two well-loved dolls. Plus, Dominic and Tim work together to fix up a rusty posterior-powered bucking bronco bicycle. S6, Ep58
Favourite Hunting Grounds. Drew takes fellow dealer Viki to some of the types of hunting ground which have helped to shape his unique take on decorative salvage and antiques. S18, Ep14
Nature In Design. Drew and Alister hunt for pieces inspired by nature, from a folk-art bird's head walking stick in Brighton to a fireside tiger in Shropshire. S18, Ep15
A family call on Alex to rescue their 43-bedroom hotel in Hampshire. The overstretched and impulsive owner has spent over $1,000,000 on this business. S13, Ep5
JJ Chalmers rescues a pile of steel sheets, an old golf bag and blanket, and a large set of drawers from Wallyford recycling centre in East Lothian. S15, Ep12
The Old Master And The Model Maker. Angus discovers a mysterious 17th century artwork in Scotland. Then, he heads to Peterborough to help clear the home of a keen model maker. S3, Ep11
James Braxton and Izzie Balmer are neck and neck as they embark on the last leg of their road trip. Who will triumph at the final auction in Lincoln? S19, Ep15
Fixing Frankenstein. Dr. Schaeffer straightens a woman's 'Z'-shaped serpentine foot to reset her life, as Dr. Vincent gets a drummer's foot back on the beat. S1, Ep9
Hornet's Nest Feet. Dr. Ebonie diagnoses a patient with feet covered in huge, wart-like masses. Dr. Brad treats a dangerous mystery case that could be related to the elephant man. S1, Ep10
Old School House. In Devon, the team investigate reports of strange figures and sensations in a historic 16th-century cottage. What will they discover during their stay? S2, Ep7
The heli-medics race to Linda, who's had a heart attack on a Norfolk beach. Motocross rider Alex is hit by a bike. And 15-year-old Dan is treated for a possible skull fracture.
Brand new series: Piglet fires the world's last remaining T3 steam engine in Dorset. A bridge repair faces a setback, and Omaha's coal-to-oil conversion reaches a key moment.
Kevin, who's 78, is rushed to A&E after going into cardiac arrest while exercising. Monica, who's 83 and has osteoporosis, has been rushed to King's after falling at home.
Vicky and Simon share a passion for Spain and their much-loved greyhounds Luna and Digby. Jasmine Harman searches inland Alicante to find property contenders for their budget of £70,000.
Teleshopping with High Street TV
Teleshopping with High Street TV
Harri and Claire welcome their rivals to the Vale of Berkeley Guesthouse in Gloucestershire, where they line up some bird-watching bingo for their guests.
Justin and Charlie host at the Artist Residence in Penzance. Most of their guests like the quirky, art-filled rooms, but a hair-raising shower dampens some spirits.
At Alec and Craig's award-winning Edenfield Guesthouse in Blackpool, Craig unleashes his cabaret-star alter-ego, Cybil Du Vaux, on his unsuspecting guests.
Stacey and Spencer host at The New Inn at Portland in Dorset. There's sandcastle building, water fights and breakfast hampers, but Claire accuses Stacey of alienating her guests.
After a week of water fights, shower frights and cabaret nights, the B&Bers meet up for one last time to find out how much they've been paid and who's won.
South Wales. Cleaning company owner Kelly Anne hopes to clean up with tried-and-tested comfort foods, a sprinkling of confidence and a large dose of Valleys warmth. (Ep1/5)
South Wales. Bar manager and former child actor Ryan plans an ambitious menu, but his first course ends up on the kitchen floor and there's a mix-up with the steak orders. (Ep2/5)
South Wales. Radio DJ Rachel's night gets off to a bad start when she all but loses her voice. Can her Indian cuisine speak for itself? (Ep3/5)
South Wales. Accountant Runa serves up Bangladeshi cuisine, but her menu is almost identical to Rachel's, who is out for revenge... (Ep4/5)
South Wales. Energy consultant David hosts a fancy affair at his palatial pad, complete with gold cutlery and a butler. But two guests find his offal-based starter too awful to eat. (Ep5/5)
Mark Canny hosts at The Bowling Green in Chorlton, where some of his guests rave about the newly refurbished rooms but others find faults. And a fridge feud leaves Mark far from chilled...
James and Fiona host at their pole-perched premier pods at Redhill Holidays in Whitbourne. Some of their guests are bowled over by the surroundings but others are bugged by creepy-crawlies.
Andrew and Qidi host at the Mode Lytham Hotel in Lancashire, where they hope to bag best in show. But some problematic parking and a 'grab-and-go' breakfast don't do it for everyone.
Petra and Martin welcome their rivals to Villa Farm Cottage in Thornton Curtis, where the bathroom tiles make one guest nostalgic and a generous breakfast leaves everyone spoilt for choice.
It's the final day of the competition. After dramatic discoveries and score-settling on everything from noisy fridges to parking, the payments are revealed and the winner is announced.
Mike's Big Buy: Mike Wolfe and Frank Fritz are California pickin' and dreamin'. And dreams become reality when Mike falls for the sweetest classic Ford pick-up he's ever seen.
Will spaniel Lance's bad habit put a dampener on Charlotte's dream? Sad Staffy Dimity needs a new pooch pal. And is Bonnie the right fit for a fast-paced family?
Champion Olympic cyclist Victoria Pendleton visits Wood Green, in search of a dog who she can co-parent with her mum. And lovebirds Shai and Orin meet Polo the lurcher.

items.t: The Secret Life of the Zoo
items.sum: The keepers think pregnant elephant Thi is three months overdue. Rampant giraffe Meru relentlessly chases the females in his herd. And young giant anteater Oso arrives at the zoo.
Brand new series: Comic crime drama from Walter Presents. A tense rural standoff ensues when a desperate farmer tries to stop his cows being slaughtered. In French/subs.
Brian, who's 74, is taken to King's by ambulance after falling down some stairs. His partner Margaret discusses their life together and the challenges of his severe dementia.
This episode meets older patients at King's hospital who've had to show resilience in their lives. And junior doctor Jim tries to get some Lego out of toddler Zara's nose.
Dara O Briain, Hugh Dennis and Andy Parsons toast ten years of satirical sideswipes with guests Katherine Ryan and Josh Widdicombe. Sepp Blatter provides ample material.
Bruno Tonioli, Adam Buxton, Kirsty Wark and Rob Beckett join brazen bluffers David Mitchell and Lee Mack to tell tall tales and uncomfortable truths. Rob Brydon presents.
Bob Mortimer and Mel Giedroyc are amongst the stars revealing improbable titbits about themselves, some of which are untrue. Can their fellow celebs pick out the porkies?
The Burrito: Eleanor, Chidi, Tahani and Jason consider how much they have improved - or not, as the case may be. Michael must deal with the consequences of his recent actions.

items.t: Dave Gorman: Modern Life Is Goodish
items.sum: I Call Mine Sally: Dave Gorman returns to offer his wry take on modern life, only on Dave. First up, he shreds some dirty magazines and helps a gerbil fulfil its destiny!
Psychiatrist and author Philippa Perry joins comedians Nabil Abdulrashid, Luke Kempner, and Sarah Millican as they take on the best-selling author's quizzing challenges.
Shopping from Home.
Shopping from Home.
Fuel-guzzling fun with Messrs Clarkson, Hammond and May. The Yorkshire Dales plays host to an epic contest between three exquisite cars. Chef Gordon Ramsay takes to the track.

items.t: Special Ops: To Catch a Criminal
items.sum: Operation Zori: A gunfight in suburban Kent leaves a victim seriously wounded and sparks a frenetic high-pressure race to hunt down the perpetrators.

items.t: Special Ops: To Catch a Criminal
items.sum: Operation Earth: An RSPCA Special Ops team investigate an international criminal puppy farming operation, and Lancashire officers prosecute an owner for animal cruelty.
Rick meets good friend, actor and comedian Barry Humphries, who fell in love with Cornwall in the 1960s when he escaped London to develop his now-famous character Dame Edna Everage.
Rick journeys on the majestic Camel Estuary to one of Britain's finest vineyards before casting his line to hook Britain's fastest fish and learning about an ambitious new idea for Cornwall.
Rick explores one of Cornwall's hidden secrets - the secluded and stunning Fowey Estuary - and makes a delicious pancake with a wild blackberry compote and Cornish clotted cream.
Rick heads out to sea on the wild north Atlantic coast to go fishing for lobsters with his old friend and celebrity chef Nathan Outlaw, then helps to cook a lobster risotto.
Cookbooks: The hairy duo cook dishes from their favourite British cookbooks and tell the story of iconic food writers, including Elizabeth David and Isabella Beeton.
Amsterdam: Timothy West and Prunella Scales embark on a voyage across the Netherlands, where they tour Amsterdam's canal district.
There's a face-off between the Aston Martin Vanquish S and Ferrari 575, the Smart ForFour is put through its paces and the aptly named Jimmy Carr hits the test track.
Human-Powered Aircraft: The motoring fan is on a mission to do the seemingly impossible - fly using muscle power alone and build the world's fastest human-powered aircraft.

Cookbooks: The hairy duo cook dishes from their favourite British cookbooks and tell the story of iconic food writers, including Elizabeth David and Isabella Beeton.
Does Kelly Hoppen wash with an orange? Did Rhod Gilbert once holiday in a French garage? Rob Brydon hosts the fact-or-fib panel show where celebs bluff and blab for points.
Comedy giant Greg Davies tells some tall tales as guest captain on the uproarious panel show where deceit is rewarded. With comic colossi Richard Osman and Phill Jupitus.
Star names turn 'true detective' in the mirthful fact-or-fiction panel show. Jo Brand, Roisin Conaty, Paul Foot and Ray Mears join Lee Mack, David Mitchell and Rob Brydon.
Mountain Rescue Dog Handler: Guy loves dogs - he therefore jumps at the opportunity to become part of a dog mountain rescue team tackling dangerous terrain as a mountain rescue guide.

items.t: Have I Got a Bit More News for You
items.sum: Richard Ayoade is host as comedian Jack Dee and broadcaster Kelly Cates join team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop to delve into the news.
Roadkill Doused In Syrup: Greg Davies sets the tasks as Tim Vine encounters a wet bra, Alice Levine barely attempts cricket, and Russell Howard makes a convincing liger.
Deadheads: Grizzled tough guy Warren Clarke takes on another mystery with his more 'by the book' colleague. A spate of mysterious fatalities at a company gives cause for concern.
It's a Knockout: An evening of dressing up in old 'It's A Knockout' costumes coincides with the arrival of Terry's company chairman for dinner. Laughs with the charming couple.
Pistols at Dawn - Part 1: Anais' off-the-books investigation into Maja's murder takes on a new dynamic when Kylie refuses to stay on the sidelines and insists on helping.
Shopping from Home.
Shopping from Home.
Special Attention: Corrupt copper Taviner leads a new recruit astray, while tension mounts as Singh and Riley try to resolve a feud between neighbours.
Nowhere to Run: Jimmi persuades a runaway groom to confront his fears and be honest with his fiancee, while Cherry is nervous about the police operation.
New Dawn: Michelle agrees to accompany an old school friend to her mother's memorial, but is not sure how to react when she witnesses her pal's father kissing another woman.
The Last Throw: Clifford must choose between the women in his life and understanding the consequences of his actions, while dealing with a medical dilemma related to someone from the past.
Fallen Stars: Rita loses her temper with a patient when she turns out to be dishonest, Cal helps a schoolgirl come to terms with her HIV and Max convinces a rock legend to come clean.
Special Attention: Corrupt copper Taviner leads a new recruit astray, while tension mounts as Singh and Riley try to resolve a feud between neighbours.
Ben's heartbreak transforms into fury when Christian gently rejects his advances - playing straight into the hands of a scheming Yusef. Janine issues Phil with a savage warning.
Phil hunts down Christian as Ben's lie sets in motion a devastating trail of events for all concerned. Amira is horrified as Yusef exploits the situation to manipulate Zainab.
Clive gives Paul some advice, but Paul thinks he is interfering so tells him to back off. Meanwhile, Des and Daphne prepare for their big day.
It's finally Des Clarke and Daphne Lawrence's big day. Des goes to the church and waits for Daphne to arrive.
Teach Me, Dear Creature: Frank and Lu delve into the competitive world of private tutoring, while a reunion presents Sebastian with a choice about his future.
The Eve of St John: Period drama series. Father Brown struggles to promote understanding when a group of pagans are suspected of killing one of their own.
Friends and Neighbours: Laughs galore in the suburban sitcom we all grew up on. The Medfords end up at each other's throats when they try to solve other people's problems.
Sinclair and the Wormley Witches: Senior silliness with the sprightly OAPs. Sinclair believes he's the victim of a curse. Truly, Entwistle and Alvin try their hand at exorcism.
Enter the Finger: The record-breaking sitcom that first came to our screens in 1973. Here, Brian Conley plays Barry's fitness-mad neighbour, who outshines him in all things physical.
Will the Genuine Racer Please Stand Up?: The young-at-heart sitcom about a group of retired friends. Howard devises a simple scheme to change his appearance enough to fool even Pearl.

items.t: Miss Marple: They Do It With Mirrors
items.sum: When Miss Marple is invited to the manor house of an old friend, it is not long before a puzzling murder puts her mind to work.
Buried Treasure: Alun Armstrong and James Bolam star in the hugely popular crime caper. When Brian's dog finds a body on a common, it prompts two people to confess to murder.
Thin Air Part 1: Thirteen years after a teenage girl was murdered, Boyd finds crucial evidence and arrests reclusive hippie Alec Garvey - but Grace doubts if he is their man.
Agent Parker steps up to protect Director Vance after a terrifying home invasion. The team notes developments in Jessica and Jimmy's blossoming romance.
While investigating the death of a fellow NCIS agent, the team realises someone has been secretly investigating them to locate a possible mole.
The unit have 72 hours to locate a man who has kidnapped, raped, and murdered four young girls. Can they find him before time runs out?
A police officer's daughter runs away and the squad uses the help of a internet journalist to track her down.
Shop by phone from the comfort of your home.
Ideal World Shopping - For All Your Shopping Needs
Two men acting strangely in a petrol station draw the suspicion of an employee. A mum calls the cops when her daughter throws water on her.
Hit and Run: American crime drama. The NCIS team investigates a Marine's car accident and ignites some upsetting memories for Abby as a young girl on the trail of her first case.
Canary: Crime drama. The NCIS team takes on a renowned hacker who could hold the key to tracking down the most-wanted cyber-terrorist in the world.
Hereafter: US naval police drama. On leave from NCIS while still grieving, director Vance discovers unexpected personal information that causes him to question everything.
US drama series. Detectives suspect an art dealer's murder is connected to her gallery, but a closer look at her personal life and family life reveals another motive.

Truckstar Smackdown. Prepare for some monster truck mayhem and very clever canines.

House Wars. It's a battle of stamina among the houses as the students compete to clock up the most exercise in one month.
Sol the Goal. Can under-15s defender Sol lead his team to victory in the Floodlit Cup?

How to Record Sound. On an exciting trip around planet Proxima, Cosima and Big Lizard record some cosmic nature sounds for Dad.
Flutter's Honour. Pancake saves Flutter, who vows to repay him, but his behaviour drives Pan to distraction.
Space Creature. Wizz meets an alien who is trying to escape galactic consequences.
Farm. When Duck and Frog work on a farm, Frog makes the perfect scarecrow. However, he gets covered in super-strong fertiliser and becomes a giant, monster-sized, chaos-causing Frog!

WOAH! So Quiet. Walter and Dennis go head to head in a sponsored silence.

Cabbage. Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the marvellous Cabbage and his dazzling super-veggie memory skills!

Robo Bingo. Mum tries to get Robo Bingo to clean its teeth, with very specific instructions.
Camping. Sula and Bing go camping to see the night sky. But then Bing sees a scary shadow...
Swophenge. Preston's standing stones aren't standing. Can Mojo's crane top take care of it?

Chest. Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young.
Dunny. Mum bans the girls from saying 'dunny', so they try and trick her into saying it instead.
Taj Mahal, India. Searching for a jewel in India, Kym discovers that the Taj Mahal is the treasure itself and must stop Grandmaster Glitch from damaging it.

Dark Red's Poster Problem. Green and Dark Red call for help from the Printing Crew to print lots of copies of a poster they've created advertising Dark Red's show.
Jam Session Day. Bad Idea Puppy is at Love Monster's house to jam but gets locked in his bathroom. When Love Monster tries to get him out through the window, he gets locked in too!
Papering Pandemonium. Justin's House has had a makeover! Robert has redecorated it. Justin loves it, but after a scooter disco inside, he accidentally creates all sorts of mess!

Back Garden. Elsee plays I-spy with her friend Bailey in his back garden.

Waffle's Talent Hunt. It's After School Club's first talent show, but Waffle must save the day.
Stormy Weather. Oona and Baba get stuck on the cliff during a storm.
March of the Ants. Twinkle and Yukee try to stop marching ants from taking seeds from the vegetable garden.
Swing Me. Elodie upsets Lu when she forgets a promise to push her on the swing.
